class.name: PhysXSeaCaveWater3D
class.brief_description: Draws the sea inside sea caves with the river's water surface.
class.description: [code]CaveNetwork3D[/code] carries the sea into each sea cave as a long wave along the passage (its surge, which answers the water contract there). This node draws that water: one ribbon per sea cave along the passage's line, each station at the water's level and half width with its current, from [code]CaveNetwork3D.get_sea_cave_water()[/code], rebuilt every frame. The surface is [PhysXRiver3D]'s (clear water, sky and sun reflections, white water where the current runs fast, and the path tracer's refracting medium). It keeps no water state of its own. A [code]CaveNetwork3D[/code] with sea caves makes one for itself while [code]sea_surge[/code] is on.

method.name: get_ribbon_count
method.description: The number of sea caves drawn.

method.name: get_water_material
method.description: The surface's material (the river's shader), shared by every ribbon.

method.name: update_now
method.description: Rebuilds the surfaces from the network now. It does so every frame; this is for tests and stills.

members.member: The [code]CaveNetwork3D[/code] whose sea caves are drawn.
How far the surface runs past the passage's half width into the walls, in metres, so no gap shows at the rock.
The current, in m/s, where white water starts. It is full at twice this speed.
